svg.title: Where does the Tukey cutoff come from?
svg.desc: The critical value is the 95th percentile of the studentized range distribution for three groups and 12 error degrees of freedom. With error mean square 4 and five observations per group, Tukey HSD is approximately 3.37 mg/L.
svg.text: MSE is the pooled within-group variance from the ANOVA.
n is the number of measurements in each group.
q critical comes from the studentized range distribution
At α = 0.05, read the 95th percentile for 3 groups and 12 error df.
